firstEntrySlide.title: Shall we add your first entry?
firstEntrySlide.description:
Tap the + button in the bottom-right corner.
A receipt photo or a sentence like 'Lunch $10' is enough; the rest fills in automatically.

entriesReady.title: Your entries are in
entriesReady.description:
You can find the imported entries on the Entries screen.
From now on, add new ones with the + button in the bottom-right corner.

later.title: Budget and forecasts can come later
later.description:
Set the year's budget from the card on Home.
Cash flow forecasts get more accurate as entries build up.
later.hasEntries: For now, browsing the imported entries is plenty.
later.noEntries: For now, a single first entry is plenty.
